title: Headless Runner And Workflow Config Model
description:
Wave 2 of the approved plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/every-single-app-must-joyful-pudding.md, continuing on from the closed ticket 26/08/01/HEADLESS-APP-ENGINE-BINARY-COMMAND-PROTOCOL-FOUNDATIONS (Waves 0-1: the plugin ABI is now a single binary exchange() call carrying protocol_channel::AppCommand/AppFrame frames; the shooting app is the converted pilot; the wasmtime host and dev-shell/renderer glue all speak the new channel).

This ticket covers Wave 2 — reshaping the headless workflow runner and the OS workflow/config model onto the same channel, so a workflow (wired apps + configuration) can run fully headless with zero UI-mock API:
- WP-2A: 🧰️framework/🛍️product/💻️os/🔨️module/🏃️run/⚡️implementation/🦀️rust/{📦️lib.rs,📦️bin.rs} — replace MediaNodeHost with an AppChannelHost trait driving nodes through AppCommand/AppFrame (the same channel the UI uses); FileBlobStore; WasmtimeNodeHost over the new wasmtime host's exchange(); resolve plugin_paths from the registry's generated 🦀️artifacts.rs instead of the hardcoded empty map; config fingerprints in the dirty-check.
- WP-2B: 🧰️framework/🛍️product/💻️os/⚡️implementation/{🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs,🟦️typescript/📦️index.ts} — OsAppInstance.config field + SetAppInstanceConfig VCS op with inverse; OsParameterFieldBinding validated against the app's config spec; parameter values materialize as a Configure frame instead of JSON-pointer document patching; TS planWorkflow mirror updated to match.
- WP-2C: root 📜️script.ts's `os run` command region — SEMIO_REPO_ROOT env plumbing so the runner can locate the registry's generated wasm-artifact paths, preflight error messaging naming the build command when an artifact is missing; new runnable targets registered in .vscode/launch.json following the existing grouping/naming convention.

Full architecture and later waves (engine offenders, per-app fan-out, consolidation, e2e proof, outliers) are in the plan file. This ticket's scope is Wave 2 only.
summary:
Wave 2 of the headless-engine/binary-command-channel program (plan: /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/every-single-app-must-joyful-pudding.md), following the closed Waves 0-1 ticket.

WP-2A: 🏃️run crate reshaped onto the channel — AppChannelHost trait (open/exchange over protocol::AppCommand/AppFrame), SpaceRunner drives each dirty node through a batched Hello→Configure→LoadDocument→MediaIn(per input)→MediaOut+MediaFingerprint(per output)→ReadDocument exchange, FileBlobStore/InMemoryBlobStore implementing store::BlobStore, media_to_artifact/media_from_artifact reusing semio_framework_plugin::app::MediaArtifactDescriptor directly (same wire shape as the guest SDK, not a duplicated struct), config_fingerprint added as a third dirty-check dimension, plugin_paths resolved from the registry's generated artifacts.rs via a SEMIO_REPO_ROOT-aware repo-root walk. FakeHost reshaped into a real in-process AppChannelHost interpreter. 6/6 tests passing including a new config-dirty-check test.

WP-2B: OsAppInstance.config field (Option<serde_json::Value>, field id 6 — verified DslValue itself has no DslField impl, so serde_json::Value via Shape::Value is the actual established schema-less-escape-hatch convention here, not dsl::DslValue as originally assumed), SetAppInstanceConfig VCS op with a real inverse mirroring MoveWorkflowNode's pattern, validate_parameter_config_binding (OsParameterType <-> ConfigFieldShape type-checking, raises a workflow/parameter-binding-invalid SpaceConflict alongside the existing edge-type-mismatch check), build_configure_config for materializing the Configure-frame payload from bound parameters. OsAppRegistration/OsAppResourceSpec gained a config: ConfigSpec field since nothing previously resolved an app instance's ConfigSpec by plugin_id/app_id. Deliberately did NOT delete the old JSON-pointer document-patching functions (apply_parameter_values_to_projection etc.) — found and verified a live, unrelated production caller (the space plugin's exportMedia handler) that would have broken with no in-scope replacement; disambiguated with doc comments instead. TS mirror needed no changes (OsAppInstance/OsOperation were never mirrored in TS, only the pure planWorkflow algorithm, which doesn't touch config).

WP-2C: root script.ts's os run command gained a real preflight (checks the generated plugin registry against the dev build's plugin-modules output, prints per-plugin build commands and exits before ever invoking cargo) and SEMIO_REPO_ROOT env plumbing for the runner's repo-root-relative artifact resolution; confirmed via actual missing-artifact and --dry-bypass runs. launch.json already had a correct os-run entry, no change needed there.

Cross-checked all three work packages' concurrent edits (WP-2A and WP-2B both touched OsAppInstance-adjacent files) build and test together cleanly: cargo build across semio-framework-os/-os-run/-plugin/-plugin-host/-protocol-channel succeeds with only pre-existing style warnings, and the only 3 test failures in semio-framework-os are pre-existing and unrelated (a stale \"studio-\" id-prefix assertion, and two tests pointing at a fixtures directory that doesn't resolve) — confirmed identical before and after this ticket's combined work.

Known follow-ups: the headless runner's config wiring only passes instance.config through directly (bin.rs) — it does not yet call build_configure_config's parameter-binding overlay, since that needs a populated per-app ConfigSpec registry that today only the renderer/dev-shell seeds; wiring that registry into the headless path is left for a later wave. A full real end-to-end wasmtime workflow run (needs a built multi-plugin fixture) is Wave 6 scope per the plan, not attempted here.
